description.narrative: This project will support Women for Change (Women led organization) in South Sudan to Co- lead the GBV coordination at Sub national level with technical support and accompaniment through mentoring and training and capturing key ongoing learning, financial management support and follow up This project will focus on 1. women's leadership including collaborative leadership, negotiation and conflict resolution. Technical GBV response including GBViE Minimum Standards , peer to peer support and Supervision. 3. Coordination skills through development of referral pathways, standard operating Procedures and resources mobilization. This project is align with Trócaire's commitment to localisation, particularly increased voice and influence of local actors with a focus on Women Lead Organization (WLOs) The Women Led Organization will take lead on quality service provision within the GBV sub cluster including on application of the minimum standards in collaboration with the National GBV AOR task team. A Women's leadership resource package will be developed to support other women led organization that consider taking on Co leadership in the future and support GBV sub cluster coordination mechanism to adapt to and follow local women's lead
